Similarly $\mathbf {\Theta _{B}}$ = $(\theta _x, \overleftarrow{\theta _{LSTM}}, \theta _s)$ corresponds to the similar set of parameters for the backward direction. Specifically, note that we share the parameters for the embedding and softmax layer across both directions. We maximize Equation 19 by training the Bi-directional LSTMs using back-propagation through time.
